extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 20-ft mobile mud lab container used for?
faqs.a: A mobile mud lab is a drilling-fluid laboratory built inside a 20-ft seafreight container. It has lab benches, instrument shelving, sample-bottle storage, HVAC, internal lighting, electrical distribution and freshwater and waste plumbing, so mud tests can be run at the well site.

faqs.q: What is fitted inside the 20-ft mobile mud lab container?
faqs.a: It is fitted with lab benches, instrument shelving, sample-bottle storage, HVAC, internal lighting, electrical distribution and freshwater and waste plumbing. A lab equipment package is supplied by Indus on request, or by the client.

faqs.q: What other lab layouts are available besides the 20-ft mobile mud lab container?
faqs.a: Cementing-lab and well-testing-lab layouts are available in 20-ft, 40-ft and customised footprints. State the testing programme and the number of staff on the RFQ so the layout is planned.

faqs.q: Why does the 20-ft mobile mud lab container have HVAC?
faqs.a: The HVAC keeps the lab and its instruments at a stable temperature in hot or dusty well-site conditions. State the ambient temperature range and power supply on the RFQ so the HVAC unit is sized.

faqs.q: Who supplies the lab equipment for the 20-ft mobile mud lab container?
faqs.a: The lab equipment package is supplied by Indus on request or by the client. State on the RFQ which instruments you want and whether you will free-issue any.

faqs.q: How is the 20-ft mobile mud lab container shipped?
faqs.a: It is built inside a 20-ft seafreight container, so it ships as standard container freight. That avoids oversize surcharges and lets it move between well sites by truck.

faqs.q: What does the 20-ft mobile mud lab container support?
faqs.a: It supports the mud system on site. See [mud tanks](/c/dw-mud-tanks), [mud degassers](/c/dw-mud-degasser) and [liquid mud plants](/c/dw-liquid-mud-plant) for the equipment whose fluids the lab tests.

faqs.q: How does the 20-ft mobile mud lab container differ from a mobile workshop?
faqs.a: A mud lab is a clean testing space with benches and plumbing, while a mobile workshop is fitted out for maintenance. Both are built in container footprints; send your needs through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Where is the 20-ft mobile mud lab container used?
faqs.a: It is used on drilling and workover sites for testing drilling fluids, and the cementing-lab and well-testing-lab layouts serve those services. See the guide on [cementing and drilling-fluid equipment](/blog/cementing-and-drilling-fluid-equipment).

faqs.q: What should I send for a mobile mud lab quotation?
faqs.a: Send the lab size (20-ft, 40-ft or custom), the tests to be run, the instrument list, the power supply, the ambient temperature and the delivery site.

faqs.q: Can the 20-ft mobile mud lab container be customised?
faqs.a: Yes. Cementing-lab and well-testing-lab layouts are listed, and the footprints can be customised. Tell us the layout and equipment so a drawing is prepared with the quotation.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 20-ft mobile mud lab container?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 20-ft mobile mud lab container as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your capacity, configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
